description: Record binding a DID-based identity to optional trust-elevation credentials (MyNumber card IC, biometric attestation). Per ADR-2605260000, this record operationalizes the L5 routing-around authentication layer. **Privacy invariant (CRITICAL): The `encryptedPayloadCid` field is mandatory and must contain XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext (per ADR-2605181100). Plaintext personal identifiers (MyNumber, biometric data, etc.) are NEVER stored on the MST; only the encrypted CID is stored.** The decrypt key is Signal-wrapped per-recipient (self + Council delegate). This record is signed by the DID's signing key.

subjectDid.description: DID of the individual binding credentials. Must be `did:web:etzhayyim.com:<authority>:<identifier>` or equivalent.

trustLevel.description: Trust level. 1 = WebAuthn platform authenticator only (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello). 2 = WebAuthn + MyNumber card IC chip binding.

webauthnCredentialId.description: Base64url-encoded WebAuthn credential ID (the unique identifier returned by navigator.credentials.create). Used by verifier to correlate to the public key in the subject DID's authentication key section.

bindingEpoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the credential binding was created.

encryptedPayloadCid.description: MANDATORY (structural enforcement via `required` and JSON Schema validation). IPFS CID (content-addressed) of the encrypted payload containing any trust-Level-2 data (MyNumber parsed IC chip response, biometric signature blob, etc.). The payload is encrypted under XChaCha20-Poly1305 per ADR-2605181100. The plaintext MUST NEVER appear on the MST. The decrypt key is Signal-wrapped per-recipient (subject DID + Council delegate DID(s)) and stored separately as `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap` records. Verification: (1) CID must be valid SHA-256 or BLAKE2b; (2) IPFS resolve CID → retrieve ciphertext; (3) unwrap Signal key for self; (4) decrypt XChaCha20; (5) parse plaintext (format TBD per R2 ADR). If `trustLevel=1`, this field MAY be null in R1 (MyNumber skipped); in R2+ it MUST be present for both levels (as per-device attestation or other L2-specific data).

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url) over the CBOR-encoded canonical form of (subjectDid, trustLevel, webauthnCredentialId, bindingEpoch, encryptedPayloadCid), signed with the subject DID's signing private key. Verifier must resolve subjectDid document, extract the signing key, and validate the signature.
